source_policy: Numeric tiers use Riot-authored 4.17 patch communiqué republished on Nerfplz. Original Riot URL unavailable in this run; copy provenance and missing native server body retained, not claimed original-runtime qualification.
native_dynamic_tooltip:
tr "game_buff_tooltip_GarenPassive" = "PerseveranceIf Garen has not been struck by damage or enemy abilities for the last @f2@ seconds, he regenerates @f1@ health every 5 seconds (@f3@% of max Health). Minion damage does not stop Perseverance.

At level 11 damage from non-epic monsters will no longer stop Perserverance.
At level 16 the power of Perserverance is increased significantly."
implemented: 9/6/4-second interrupt cooldown and 0.4/0.8/2.0 percent max-health regeneration per second at levels 1/11/16.
Champion/structure/epic incoming damage interrupts; lane minion damage does not; ordinary monster damage exempts level 11 and above.
Passive healing adds separately to base/item regeneration and clamps at max HP; no dead or ended-match healing.
Interruption tick replicates in authoritative snapshot.
Explicit server event for non-damaging enemy ability hit; no client authority granted.
limits: 30Hz linear tick healing and shielded positive mitigated damage interruption reconstructed; original exact native tick/shield policies unqualified.
Unknown/environmental None-source positive damage conservatively interrupts; native special exceptions incomplete.
Cooldown uses current level relative to last interruption; exact level transition/death/respawn behavior needs original-runtime qualification.
Non-damaging ability event API exists but full per-ability event producers remain incomplete.
Native VFX/audio/HUD and full Garen kit not qualified.
